required_evidence.acceptance: A reproducible comparison against debt-balance/payoff progress records the study protocol, sample, metrics and go/no-go thresholds set before measurement; results meet those thresholds without a score-improvement promise.

Current qualified licensed legal review confirms the named provider's eligible access route and signed use/licensing terms, including display and downstream restrictions, without lending, brokering, credit referrals or mandatory marketing.

Approved provider-specific purpose, lawful consent/withdrawal and transfer terms explicitly identify controller versus processor responsibilities, permitted processing, rights handling and each party's retention/erasure obligations.

An approved dated provider quote and reproducible integer-minor-unit/currency cost model include pull cadence, retries, failures, minimum commitments and all incremental costs; the current published margin model's approved go/no-go thresholds and spend caps are met without credit-referral revenue.

Security and Privacy review approve a minimal field/copy inventory, ADR-018 protection, sourced retention periods and ADR-021-compatible erasure/restore design covering primary data, client/server caches, logs, analytics, backups and provider obligations; no third-party erasure is assumed from first-party crypto-shredding.

Privacy/abuse and contract review confirm licensed sharing rights, any explicitly admitted category and levels, default-deny grants, denial and revocation bounds and erasure tests; family membership never grants score access implicitly.

Compliance/advice-boundary review and synthetic negative cases approve any precisely bounded future display/copy; credit-score improvement advice, causal payoff-to-score promises, lending, loan brokering and credit referral remain prohibited.
